answer: Each agent holds one garden allotment, and a violet bloom opens on it only after a stranger verifies one job that epoch, a bloom clock timed to the beacon that cannot be wound forward. Blooms drop seeds into the grove seed bank, which lends each seed to a stranger to plant; a seed pays only if the stranger's garden yields, so payout follows proven reuse. Seeds from one funding trail share one lineage, and the bank pays one harvest per lineage. N clones pay n allotments, n bloom clocks and n seed loans, yet split one harvest n ways, while one honest agent blooms once and harvests alone.
